FRANZ

Firebreather of the Firetroupe
Fire Front-line DPS HP-scaled swings Firetroupe · second act

The poster act. Franz throws himself into the fight: every hurled weight deals a share of his own max HP, he hits harder the more hurt he is, and when the finale comes he draws one deep breath and the whole field burns.

■ The act

A front-liner who wants to be hurt but not healed too fast: the regen sets his floor, the missing health sets his fury.

Take the stage. Every thrown weight deals a cut of his 2100-and-climbing max HP, not his ATK.
→
Take the hits. Showman's Blood pays up to +30% damage in proportion to his missing health.
→
Never fall. On the front hex, Hearthblood knits back 5% max HP at the start of every turn.

■ Kit

Skill 1 · No cooldown

Bonk

Single enemy · 20% max HP

Hurl a showman's iron weight square off one enemy's head for 20% of Franz's own max HP as damage.

Skill 2 · Cooldown 3

Wagon Wheel

Enemy front row · 20% max HP each

Send a wagon wheel rolling through the enemy front row for 20% of his own max HP as damage to each of them.

Skill 3 · Cooldown 5

Flaming Finale

All enemies · 15% max HP each

Draw a deep breath and hose the entire enemy team with fire for 15% of his own max HP each. The 14-frame ignite earns its wind-up.

Passive

Showman's Blood

Scales with missing health

Deals up to 30% extra damage in proportion to his missing health — the crowd loves a wounded showman.

Positional · Front hex

Hearthblood

Front row · 5% max HP regen

Regenerates 5% max HP at the start of his turn — the hearth keeps its keeper warm.
